evidence.detail: The current Doctor policy call remains a positional scalar membrane.
The runtime can transport typed records, but this does not migrate the policy caller.

reproduction.instructions: Inspect Doctor parity coverage and its native policy call against the pushed language/runtime boundary.
reproduction.result: Typed record round-trip coverage exists, while the canonical Doctor caller still constructs positional scalar arguments.

summary: The typed native invocation capability is available and proven by Ravel and mncs-debug, but Doctor still crosses its native policy boundary through scalar positional arguments; the pressure remains unresolved.

workaround.description: Doctor continues to maintain scalar positional invocation knowledge until its policy boundary is migrated.
